FN-ZYVARRK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 247
Committee: Ports, Waterways, and Intermodal Sponsor: Representative David Standridge
Transit
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2025
House Bill 247 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of various state and
local entities to update pre-existing resources to reflect the renaming of the Gulf of Mexico to
the "Gulf of America."
